project-assignment-receipt.test: project assignment verifies a lost native acknowledgment and rejects the wrong host

archive-receipt.test: reopening an incomplete archive batch checks submitted items and never resends them

archive-registration-replay.test: a repeated batch registration accepts only the original ordered targets

archive-finish-before-claim.test: finishing a batch during preflight leaves the item unsubmitted

archive-finish-after-failed-preflight.test: a failed preflight cannot change an item after its batch finishes

archive-finish-after-claim.test: an item claimed before its batch finishes still records the native result

archive-schedule-settings.test: archive deadlines follow the current host settings and configured time boundaries

legacy-archive-section-version.test: a previously registered unscoped archive batch keeps its pending and unsent semantics

retired-connection.test: a disconnected catalog host retires pending reads and prior connection epochs

native-method-scope.test: native discovery and title calls use the existing connection with specific methods

discovery-coverage.test: discovery pages interactive sources across all providers and keeps the newest duplicate

discovery-limit.test: an incomplete discovery retains partial discoveries and leaves missing cards read-only

discovery-repeated-cursor.test: a repeated discovery cursor preserves read cards and reports the scan as incomplete

discovery-reconnect.test: remote cache survives removal, a failed scan, reconnect, and a confirmed archive

navigation-exact-thread.test: opening rejects invalid, undiscovered and mismatched threads and uses the verified host

stale-account-edit.test: an in-flight same-column edit cannot persist after the active Codex account switches

stale-account-card.test: a stale card cannot save or register an archive after a switch to identical native revisions

preview-previous-complete.test: preview reads the previous complete answer from the verified remote while a turn runs

preview-confirm-latest.test: preview discards an obsolete response and retries after the current turn changes

preview-errors.test: preview distinguishes an empty history from malformed pages and runtime read failures

launcher-deployment-paths.test: relocated installations use their own Codex profile and desktop socket

launcher-configured-paths.test: the installer and launcher resolve configured source, command and socket paths

history-rotation.test: historical read failures rotate and old interrupted turns do not change native placement

history-review-suggestion.test: an old final reply suggests review without issuing a move or changing the current state

runtime-real-stages.test: automatic pause, resume and completion follow native evidence and preserve the manual note

runtime-pending-move.test: a durable pending phase is recovered after restart without repeating an applied move

runtime-passive-input.test: passive history and queued text cannot start or finish a turn

first-input-revision.test: first native input advances the same revision before a save or a history scan

archive-independent-readback.test: a reopened batch reconciles uncached submitted cards on connected hosts independently

runtime-manual-selection.test: manual placement survives same-turn output and restart until the stage changes

runtime-confirmed-errors.test: only confirmed failures and interruptions move a running turn to blocked

legacy-change-history.test: legacy change histories keep their source sequence and separate same-ID hosts

legacy-change-rollback.test: migration rollback removes projected histories and keeps later manual changes

service-build-identity.test: CLI reuses the selected build and rejects a same-version update until the host restarts

service-config-identity.test: CLI refuses a changed board configuration or port and can still stop the former service

service-directory-identity.test: CLI rejects a copied receipt across data directories and public info omits its identity

service-live-owner.test: an unreachable live host keeps its state directory and cannot be replaced

service-drain.test: CLI stop waits for the verified service to drain before reporting success

service-replacement.test: a client bound to a stopped instance cannot close its replacement

title-deadline.test: a bounded native call ignores a reply received after its deadline

title-manual-projection.test: manual saves sync the latest full title and strip only leading state prefixes

title-epoch.test: enabling and reopening do not rename historical activity; new automatic states sync

title-concurrency.test: foreground save supersedes a running title job without waiting for its reply

title-restart.test: restart reconciles a lost rename receipt without repeating an applied write

title-retry-after-restart.test: a rejected native rename preserves the saved card and is retried after reopening

title-fair-retry.test: a frequently failing title retries behind other pending cards

title-shared-budget.test: a hanging native context respects the shared three-second title budget

section-replicas.test: section preflight only accepts unique replicas on the queried host

frozen-cross-replay.coverage: 指定提交的 Rust 及当前 TypeScript 分别运行同一独立模型的 520 条状态边和 1417 次操作，检查状态、版本、备注和查看、重开的持久数据。

http-security.test: HTTP and PWA use loopback, active origin and validated shared operations

offline-cache.test: offline account-specific snapshots never reissue writes or previews

operation-routing.test: all 18 HTTP routes and MCP tools forward the same arguments and return the same result

mcp-stdio.test: CLI mcp negotiates stdio, reads its packaged app and reports rejected saves

cli-instance.test: CLI reuses the authorized instance and stop only closes its compatibility service

sections-import.test: migrate-sections retains the source and refuses to overwrite an existing output

cli-import.test: CLI migrate imports a live SQLite WAL and refuses an existing destination

migration-wal.test: live committed WAL from all hosts is backed up without reading runtime files

migration-projection.test: projection retains revisions, pending work, and same thread IDs per explicitly bound host

migration-retry.test: migration refuses occupied destinations, rolls back privately, and can retry

migration-offline.test: databases for offline hosts survive if the main database is missing

legacy-offline-card.test: a bound remote migration is visible even if Codex has never connected

legacy-offline-authority.test: a migrated remote card belongs to the bound user and yields to native discovery

release-paths.test: compiled files sit in dist and runtime data stays in the repository

release-rollback.test: activation and rollback retain data and the previous immutable release

install-first-retry.test: a failed first install restores the original archive and can be retried

install-upgrade-retry.test: a failed loader upgrade restores the prior patched archive, link and receipt

native-draft-concurrency.test: overlapping requests share one native draft open and can resume after registration

release-rejection.test: platform mismatch and symlink entries are rejected

ipc-frame.test: ipc accepts only the top-level app frame
